name: Chintamani Centro de Retiros
technique: Mindfulness of breathing, metta bhavana, plus Triratna study and ritual
teacherAccess: Visiting Order members occasionally join; otherwise sangha-led
retreatOptions: 3-4 day weekend retreats up to week-long retreats
about: A 3+ hectare property owned and run by the Mexican Triratna sangha, used for weekend and week-long meditation retreats combining silent sitting, study, and communal work, drawing from CDMX/Cuernavaca practice groups. Program-calendar details were harder to verify than for other entries (site loads as a JS app); flagged for a final spot-check before treating pricing as current.
cost: Roughly 2,650-5,500 MXN per retreat depending on length

pricePerDay.notes: Derived from a ~4-day retreat priced around 2,650-3,600 MXN.

workNotes: Light communal chores customary, not formally required.
